title: Correlated sign-vector pair distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. Choose $X$ uniformly from $\{\pm1\}^n$, then draw $Y$ from the independent coordinate noise kernel with parameter $\rho$ applied to $X$. The resulting joint probability distribution is that of $(X,Y)$.
caveat: The coordinate keep probability used by the noise kernel is not defined in the supplied snippet.
